snippet.title: GeoFunGames Gameplay - Map Game, Flag Reveal 1v1 & Guess the City
snippet.description:
Official gameplay of GeoFunGames, a free browser game site where you learn geography by playing.

In this video:
- Map Explorer - find countries on an interactive world map
- Flag Reveal 1v1 - race a real opponent to guess a flag as it is revealed
- Guess the City - identify cities from satellite images

GeoFunGames runs in any browser on desktop and mobile, in 9 languages. Climb the leaderboards, keep your daily streak and rank up as an explorer.
